rules.title: Build a five-incident log
rules.summary: San José Animal Care requires a case number and a signed nuisance log with at least five documented incidents.
rules.captureInstruction: Record the start time, end time, duration, and how the barking interfered with the reasonable use of your home.
rules.nextAction: Contact Animal Care first for a case number. After five incidents, submit the signed petition and original log.

rules.title: Report it while it is happening
rules.summary: San José directs active noise disturbances to the Police Department's non-emergency line.
rules.captureInstruction: Measure from the place where the disturbance affects you. Keep a separate record of each date, time, and duration.
rules.nextAction: For an active ordinary noise disturbance, call the police non-emergency line. Use emergency services only for an immediate threat.
rules.officialSourceLabel: City of San José contact directory

rules.title: Check the permit and the clock
rules.summary: For construction covered by a development permit or planning approval within 500 feet of a residence, San José generally allows work only from 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., Monday through Friday. An approved permit may allow different hours.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the work address, activity, start and end times, approximate distance from the nearest home, and any posted permit or after-hours notice.
rules.nextAction: Check for a posted permit or approved exception. If the work appears outside its allowed hours, submit a Code Enforcement service request with the address and your incident history.
